observation.visible_scene: A static, close-up outdoor shot on sunlit asphalt: a car's silver five-spoke alloy wheel and black tire bear down on a cut watermelon half (striped green rind facing left, exposed red flesh on the right), which lies beside stacked concrete cinder blocks. A white body panel is visible at the far left edge.
visible_changes: The wheel's spokes rotate steadily across the segment, indicating the tire is rolling slowly rather than sitting still.

The watermelon is progressively crushed: the green rind flattens and deforms under the tire's weight, and the red interior is squeezed outward, spreading into a wet pulp mass to the right and onto the ground.
In the later frames the rind splits open and red pulp/juice smears and sprays onto the asphalt to the left, beneath the tire's contact edge.
The cinder blocks, horizon, and trees stay in fixed positions, consistent with a stationary camera; the main motion is the wheel rotation and the watermelon's deformation.
outside_clip_unknowns: The instant the tire first touched the watermelon and any prior motion of the car.
Whether the car continues rolling past the watermelon or stops after the excerpt.
The final state of the crushed fruit beyond the last frame.
uncertain_details: The precise balance between tire rotation and forward translation is hard to pin down; the wheel appears to roll in place while pressing the fruit.
Minor apparent shifts of the white bodywork at the left edge could be car movement or framing and are not clearly resolvable.
Whether the leftward pulp spray is from the rind splitting or from juice forced out under pressure is not directly shown.
